candidates.title: Task-Specific Expert Pruning for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
candidates.reason: downstream taskで寄与の小さいexpertをprogressiveにdropし、MoEをsingle-expert dense modelまで縮小して99.3% benefit維持・2x inference speedを報告する初期の直接的expert pruning。

candidates.title: Memory-efficient NLLB-200: Language-specific Expert Pruning of a Massively Multilingual Machine Translation Model
candidates.reason: NLLB-200 MoEでlanguage-specific expertを特定し、追加fine-tuningなしで最大80% expert削除・4 GPUから1 GPUへ縮小する実用的expert pruning。

candidates.title: Soft Merging of Experts with Adaptive Routing
candidates.reason: discrete routingを避け、expert parameterのweighted averageで単一merged expertを動的構築するSMEAR。adaptive routingとexpert mergingを直接結びつける基礎系。

candidates.title: Sparse MoE as the New Dropout: Scaling Dense and Self-Slimmable Transformers
candidates.reason: activated expert数へのoverfittingを抑え、推論/下流fine-tuningでexpert数を変えられるself-slimmable sparse MoEを狙う。

candidates.title: DeepSpeed-MoE: Advancing Mixture-of-Experts Inference and Training to Power Next-Generation AI Scale
candidates.reason: MoE model sizeを最大3.7x圧縮するarchitecture/compressionとoptimized inferenceを統合し、MoE inferenceの初期system baselineとして重要。
